title: 第一卷 第19章 巧妙破阵天才阵师第一卷 第20章 杀人夺果周家
lines: “尘儿，你没事吧？”
战斗结束后，苏晴雨将叶无尘全身仔细检查了一遍，发现没什么伤痕后，这才放心下来。
“不碍事的，苏姐姐，我身体皮实着呢！”
叶无尘憨厚一笑，虎头虎脑的，看起来甚是可爱。
苏晴雨摸了摸他的小脑袋，眸光宠溺，略带着几分责怪口吻道：“尘儿，这里可是迷雾森林，危机重重，你可不许再瞎跑了，要时刻待在我身边知道吗？”
“苏姐姐，我知道了。”叶无尘点点头。
“另外，我不是和你说了嘛，要叫我师父！”
“苏姐姐那么年轻漂亮，叫师父不是把人叫老了嘛，我还是喜欢叫苏姐姐。”
“你呀你，这么小就知道油嘴滑舌了！”
苏晴雨无奈摇摇头，三千青丝如瀑布般垂落，风华绝代，气质出尘。
“这赤瞳妖猪，肉质最是鲜美了，之前我们临走匆忙，没有准备好干粮，这几天现在就靠它填饱肚子了！”
叶无尘从乾坤坠的储物空间中取出一把匕首，将妖猪身体分割成块状，然后穿成串开始进行烧烤，撒上佐料，顿时肉质金黄油亮，香味扑鼻。
整个过程熟练无比。
“好香啊！”
苏晴雨接过烤串，不禁食欲大增，浅浅尝一口后，美眸中闪过异彩道：“尘儿，你这烤肉的本事哪里学来的，真厉害！”
叶无尘吃着烤肉，表情享受道：“之前我和娘亲住在侯府后山，有人故意克扣我们的粮食，导致总是吃不饱，于是娘亲就会在后山打猎，做烧烤给我吃，久而久之就熟练了。”
“太过分了，居然连口粮都克扣你娘俩的！”苏晴雨听得一阵气愤。
却只见叶无尘一脸淡然道：“这不算什么，若非当初娘亲忍辱负重，答应贬谪为妾，我早已胎死腹中，连来到人间的机会都没有。”
“尘儿，你受委屈了。”苏晴雨神情动容。不禁心疼地摸了摸他的脑袋。
“不委屈，我好歹有娘亲疼爱，娘家人的爱护！”
叶无尘说到此处，看了苏晴雨一眼道：“说到委屈，苏姐姐，你才是真正的委屈，自小就孤苦无依，一人独自面对这险恶的世界。”
一时间，苏晴雨内心最柔软的地方被戳中，眼中泪水流转道：“是啊，自小我苏家就被灭了满门，我却至今都未曾查到真凶是谁！”
叶无尘安慰道：“会查到的，皇天不负苦心人，真相终有一日会浮出水面。”
“我如今所剩时日已不多，只怕就算查到了真相，也无法为族人报仇……”
苏晴雨说到此处，不禁又咳嗽了几声，浑身冰冷，寒毒发作的前期症状再次出现。
她立即搜寻自己的储物戒，想要寻找什么东西。
“苏姐姐，你要的是这个吧？”
这时，叶无尘从乾坤坠中取出一个红色酒葫芦。
“是烈火酒，尘儿，这是你特意为我准备的嘛？”
苏晴雨接过酒葫芦，不禁刹那失神，一阵感动，内心觉得暖暖的。
她之前寒毒发作时，就是靠喝这种酒缓解寒毒症状的，奈何今天临行匆忙，未曾准备。
“嗯，之前就见苏姐姐喝过这种酒。”叶无尘点点头。
content_en:
"Chen'er, are you okay?"
After the battle, Su Qingyu carefully inspected Ye Wuchen's whole body and felt relieved after finding that there were no scars.
"It's okay, Sister Su, I'm pretty skinny!"
Ye Wuchen smiled innocently, looking very cute.
Su Qingyu touched his little head, her eyes were fond of her, and she said in a slightly reproachful tone: "Chen'er, this is a misty forest, full of dangers. You can't run around anymore, you have to stay by my side at all times, you know?"
"Sister Su, I understand." Ye Wuchen nodded.
"Besides, didn't I tell you to call me Master!"
"Sister Su is so young and beautiful. Calling her master doesn't make her look old. I still like to call her sister Su."
"You, you, you know how to be glib at such a young age!"
Su Qingyu shook her head helplessly. Three thousand black hair fell down like a waterfall, showing her unparalleled elegance and unparalleled aura.
"This red-eyed monster pig has the most delicious meat. We were in a hurry before leaving and didn't prepare any dry food. Now we rely on it to fill our stomachs these days!"
Ye Wuchen took out a dagger from the storage space of the Qiankun Pendant, cut the body of the demon pig into pieces, then skewered it and started grilling it, sprinkled with seasonings, and the meat was immediately golden and shiny, with a fragrant aroma.
The whole process was extremely skillful.
"It smells so good!"
Su Qingyu took the skewers and her appetite increased. After taking a small bite, her beautiful eyes flashed with excitement and said: "Chen'er, where did you learn this barbecue skill? It's really amazing!"
Ye Wuchen ate the barbecue and said with an expression of enjoyment: "My mother and I lived in the back mountain of the Hou Mansion before. Someone deliberately deducted our food, resulting in us not having enough to eat. So my mother would hunt in the back mountain and cook barbecue for me to eat. Over time, I became proficient."
"That's too much. I even deducted rations from you and your mother!" Su Qingyu felt angry after hearing this.
But Ye Wuchen said calmly: "This is nothing. If my mother had not endured the humiliation and agreed to be demoted as a concubine, I would have been stillborn and would not have even had a chance to come to the world."
"Chen'er, you have been wronged." Su Qingyu looked moved. I couldn't help but touch his head distressedly.
"I'm not wronged. I have the love of my mother and the love and protection of my mother's family!"
When Ye Wuchen said this, he glanced at Su Qingyu and said: "Speaking of grievances, Sister Su, you are the real grievance. You have been lonely and helpless since you were a child, facing this dangerous world alone."
For a moment, the softest part of Su Qingyu's heart was poked, and tears flowed in her eyes: "Yes, my Su family has been wiped out since I was a child, but I have never found out who the real murderer is!"
Ye Wuchen comforted: "It will be found out. Huangtian will pay off his hard work. The truth will eventually surface."
"I don't have much time left now. I'm afraid that even if I find out the truth, I won't be able to avenge my people..."
When Su Qingyu said this, she couldn't help coughing a few more times, her whole body felt cold, and the early symptoms of cold poison appeared again.
She immediately searched her storage ring, looking for something.
"Sister Su, is this what you want?"
At this time, Ye Wuchen took out a red wine gourd from the Qiankun Pendant.
"It's strong fire wine, Chen'er. Did you prepare this specially for me?"
Su Qingyu took the wine gourd and couldn't help but lose consciousness for a moment. She was moved and felt warm in her heart.
When she had an attack of cold poison before, she relied on drinking this wine to relieve the symptoms of cold poison. However, she was in a hurry before leaving today and was not prepared.
"Well, I've seen Sister Su drink this kind of wine before." Ye Wuchen nodded.
